transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been bothering you or what brings you here today?

Yeah… I guess what brought me in is that people are noticing how I’m moving, or not moving, kind of. Like sometimes I feel like I’m moving underwater—getting out of a chair takes forever, answering someone takes too long. At work that’s awkward, because customer service is all about answering fast, and then someone thinks you’re ignoring them.

But then other times I’m the opposite, like I’ll be pacing around my apartment and rubbing my hands together, like I’m trying to shake off a bad call or something. I don’t know, it’s just… visible now. Other people can see it, so I figured I should probably talk to someone.
Have you experienced any periods where you felt down, depressed, or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks?

Yeah… yes, I think so. It’s not like just a bad week. It’s been kind of sitting there for… a little over two years now, maybe two years and a month or so. It eases up sometimes, like I’ll have a stretch where I can sort of breathe and I think, okay, maybe it’s lifting, but then it comes back.

Sorry, I’m trying to answer directly. Yes—most days, for a long time.
Have you noticed that you don’t take pleasure or interest in things you used to enjoy, like hobbies, work, or spending time with friends or family?

Yeah… I have. It’s weird because I still set the stuff out like I’m going to do it. I used to sketch a lot—just in a notebook, nothing impressive—and I’d make these little coffee notes too, like trying different beans or whatever. I had a whole system at one point, which sounds kind of ridiculous now.

And weekends, I used to hike sometimes. Not huge mountains or anything, just trails where you can be quiet. Lately I’ll open the notebook, or I’ll lace up my boots, and it’s like… there’s just nothing pulling me toward it. I don’t feel excited or even peaceful from it. It’s just objects sitting there.
Can you describe one of these periods when you felt down or hopeless—when it started, how long it lasted, and if there was anything that seemed to make it better or worse?

It started… I guess if I’m being honest, about two years ago. Maybe a little more—like two years and a month? I remember thinking it was just a rough patch at first, and then it kept being there.

It’s not every single minute, like sometimes it eases up for a bit and I can function a little better, and I’ll think, “Okay, maybe that’s done.” But it’s usually just a short break, and then the heaviness comes back. I don’t know if anything really fixes it. Sometimes it feels less bad for a little while, but it doesn’t stay gone.
